svg.title: AMIGA — learning which consensus network to choose
svg.desc: Conceptual AMIGA core workflow, based on repository commit 1eaef45bee2d58807e8563b01eefee4724fe4b2f. All matrices, fronts, network diagrams and score bars are schematic, not empirical results. No reference image or generative image model is used by the builder.

g.aria-label: From alternative consensus networks to a ranked recommendation — without reference labels at prediction time.
g.title: From alternative consensus networks to a ranked recommendation — without reference labels at prediction time.

g.aria-label: Known reference links reveal which candidates deserve higher priority.
g.title: Known reference links reveal which candidates deserve higher priority.

g.aria-label: Recommend a network for new data
g.title: Recommend a network for new data

g.aria-label: The learned decision rule scores new candidates without a reference network.
g.title: The learned decision rule scores new candidates without a reference network.

g.aria-label: One table row per candidate network
g.title: One table row per candidate network

g.aria-label: expression context is shared by a front.
g.title: expression context is shared by a front.

g.aria-label: Learn to rank within each front
g.title: Learn to rank within each front

g.aria-label: Features predict an ordering, not a cutoff
g.title: Features predict an ordering, not a cutoff

g.aria-label: Prefer candidates with higher quality labels
g.title: Prefer candidates with higher quality labels

g.title: Refit on all labelled fronts after CV

g.title: One table row per candidate network

g.title: Output: score + rank within each front

g.aria-label: Quality labels supervise learning; they are not prediction inputs.
g.title: Quality labels supervise learning; they are not prediction inputs.

g.aria-label: AMIGA prioritizes existing candidates; it does not generate a new network.
g.title: AMIGA prioritizes existing candidates; it does not generate a new network.
